classification: pinned kernel source inspection; not runtime evidence
findings: of-fpga-region PRE_REMOVE returns NOTIFY_OK; bridge disable happens POST_REMOVE after device detach
of_overlay_remove honors PRE_REMOVE errors before reverting nodes
fpga_region_program_fpga calls get_bridges before disabling bridges; exclusion must precede disable and block new allocations throughout configuration
ordinary platform DMA configure holds default-domain owner count through driver binding; cleanup releases it on unbind
IOMMU group type changes refuse while owner count is held, except enabling DMA-FQ on an existing DMA domain
iommu_device_use_default_domain is a driver-core pre-probe API, not an exported provider lease callback
next: Use a permanent device binding for actual DMA/domain lifetime and early configuration/remove exclusion, with opaque owner handles for post-client-close drain retries. Device references alone do not retain binding/resources.
